events.verdict: Chandler (PHX) legally contests Aldridge's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
The contact between Forbes (SAS) and Jackson (PHX) occurs after the shot clock expires.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a shot clock violation is confirmed.
James (PHX) makes marginal contact with Mills (SAS) that does not affect his SQBR.
James (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball from Mills (SAS).
Mills (SAS) and James (PHX) make incidental contact with each other during the loose ball.
Aldridge (SAS) receives the pass and takes a legal amount of steps after his gather.
Chandler (PHX) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Aldridge (SAS) after the release of his jump shot.
Forbes (SAS) dislodges the ball from Jackson (PHX) during the rebound.
Forbes (SAS) clamps the arm of Jackson (PHX), affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
James (PHX) makes incidental contact with Mills (SAS) that does not affect his SQBR.
Aldridge (SAS) grabs Jackson (PHX) around the waist and affects his ability to defend the play.
Mills (SAS) clamps Jackson's (PHX) right arm and affects his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Jackson (PHX) commits a take foul on Murray (SAS).
Chandler (PHX) briefly grasps Aldridge's (SAS) jersey, but does not affect his FOM.
James (PHX) commits a take foul on Mills (SAS).
Chandler (PHX) firms up and sets the screen on Forbes (SAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Dudley (PHX) lifts his pivot foot.
